title: ...open a new Gmail account
desc: Protect your privacy and lock down your digital life immediately.
todos: Enable App-based Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) in Google Settings.
Add and verify a secure recovery email address.
Review and complete the Google Privacy Checkup prompts.
Turn off automated web activity & location tracking history.
Set up a custom email signature and clean up inbox categories.

title: ...suspect someone is having a stroke
desc: Act FAST to identify critical stroke symptoms and save lives.
todos: F - Face Drooping: Ask the person to smile and check if one side droops.
A - Arm Weakness: Ask the person to raise both arms and see if one drifts downward.
S - Speech Difficulty: Ask the person to repeat a simple phrase to check for slurring.
T - Time to Call 911: Call emergency services immediately if you observe any sign.
Note the exact time symptoms first appeared to tell first responders.

title: ...walk into a new hotel room
desc: Ensure your quarters are secure, sanitary, and functional before unpacking.
todos: Check mattress corners, seams, and headboard immediately for signs of bedbugs.
Verify the deadbolt, door lock latch, and peep-hole function properly.
Locate the nearest emergency fire exit stairs down your hallway.
Sanitize high-touch surfaces like the TV remote and bathroom faucet handles.
Test the air conditioning, safe lock, and hot water operation.

title: ...get into a minor car accident
desc: Keep a level head, document evidence, and protect yourself legally on the road.
todos: Safely move your vehicle out of traffic and turn on hazard lights.
Check all passengers and drivers for injuries; call 911 if needed.
Photograph vehicle damage, license plates, street signs, and overall scene.
Exchange contact, insurance policy, and driver's license details with the other driver.
Report the incident to your insurance provider and file an official police report.

title: ...open a High-Yield Savings Account (HYSA)
desc: Maximize your interest earnings while keeping your emergency fund safe.
todos: Verify the financial institution is FDIC or NCUA insured up to $250,000.
Compare Annual Percentage Yields (APY), monthly fees, and minimum balance rules.
Link a primary checking account via secure ACH electronic transfer.
Set up automatic recurring monthly transfers to build your savings habit.
Designate official account beneficiaries for financial security.

title: ...start your very first sourdough starter
desc: Begin cultivation for home-baked artisanal sourdough bread.
todos: Combine equal parts whole wheat flour and unchlorinated water in a clean glass jar.
Cover loosely with a cloth or lid to allow wild yeast airflow while keeping dust out.
Store in a warm spot (70°F–80°F) away from direct sunlight.
Discard half the mixture daily and feed with fresh flour and water at 24-hour intervals.
Watch for active bubbling and doubling in size over 5 to 7 days before baking.
